in_marathi.name: Deepam
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lamp, Light, Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deepam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deepam is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Deepa’ meaning a lamp or light. In Hindu mythology, Deepam signifies knowledge, wisdom, and enlightenment. It is believed that Deepam represents the inner light that guides us through our spiritual journey.
